title: Resize Test
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Resize
learningObjectives: Explain how a full-screen toggle icon drawn in the lower-right corner lets a sketch switch between embedded and full-screen modes
Distinguish the p5.js windowWidth and windowHeight variables from the canvas width and height reported on screen
Trace how a mouse click inside the resize icon's bounding rectangle triggers the full-screen toggle
Predict how the reported window dimensions change when the sketch enters and leaves full-screen mode
Design a hit-test that determines whether a click landed within a small control region of the canvas
